text:
really good quote on understanding how assets are priced

-not abt "good" or "bad"
-not about if things are getting "better" or "worse"
-its about 2nd deriv: the RATE of "better" or "worse" relative to mkt-implied expectations

takes a shitload of time + reps to fully grasp this

quotedTweet.text:
credit to Bill Miller for this great quote from six years ago

lays out in simple terms how markets operate:

#1: bad news doesn't matter.

#2: news getting worse doesn't matter.

#3: all that matters is the RATE (ie 2nd derivative of #2) at which news is getting better or worse: https://t.co/PAihA2MEBX
